evals.prompt: I want to add a weekly summary email that shows users their stats from the past week
evals.expected_output: Should reject the proposal (weekly not daily, consumption not discipline) but counter-propose something retention-driving that strengthens one of the Four Hooks

evals.prompt: What should we build next to improve retention?
evals.expected_output: Should propose 3-5 concrete retention improvements ranked by impact, using the Four Hooks and Invisible Psychology frameworks. Should audit existing features and find gaps.

evals.prompt: I want to add a screen where users can see all their past reflections in a scrollable list
evals.expected_output: Nuanced evaluation — should see the variable reward hook (re-reading old reflections that hit differently now) but also flag content consumption risk. Should propose a version that passes.
